notes.title: 【7月14日】《过阴》V1.02版本更新公告：
notes.notes:
1.修复了主界面WASD可以移动的问题。
2.增加配音、背景音调节功能。现在可以在设置界面中分别调整背景音与对话的音量了。

notes.title: Mirages First Round of Fixes and Adjustments.
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your testing and feedback in the past two days. We have received many suggestions and made the first round of adjustments based on them.

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
1.Added clearer guidance prompts for some unclear objectives.
2.Adjusted some air walls in certain scenes.
3.Fixed some character displacement issues caused by interactions.
4.Optimized the presentation of some scenes.
5.Optimized lighting guidance.

Thank you for your feedback and suggestions. We hope you have a great time playing the game!

notes.title: 《Mirages》Demo Live Now !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! The demo of Mirages is live now ！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43104850/74f2718495cbb813c6a7ef6644949040a064891a.png[/img]

Set in a small town in the Republic of China ruled by warlords, Mirages is a horror narrative with Chinese Folklore, in which you and the group of protagonists will explore and adventure in a treacherous and bizarre event to uncover the truth. Mirages is also a sequel to our previous game Way Back Home. For veteran players, it is very gratifying to see characters such as Yao Lu, Yuan Qiao,  Huaiqin Yan, and Rong Qiao back in a new look, and hope you can experience more in this brand-new story.

To all players, please try it out! We are adding English language to the demo， don't forget to add the game to your wishlist, as it's very important to us! Should you have any feedback about the game, please feel free to join the official groups below and communicate with us at:

We'll keep working on it. See you again at the official release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772060

notes.title: [04.03] "Mirages" Demo Update Announcement
notes.notes:
According to feedback from beta testers and data collected from a small group of early access users, we have made the following adjustments to the demo content that will be released on April 3rd:

Optimized some air walls with rigid presentation.
Added more guidance prompts and guiding lights.
Adjusted some of the maps' automatic saving points.
Updated the music presentation part of the trailer video.
Fixed known bugs (directional keys malfunctioning, characters getting stuck while loading maps).
After the small group early access test opened last week, we updated the demo version seven times and will continue to provide demo experiences and collect player feedback to optimize and update the game.
Tomorrow, our previous work, "Way Back Home," will also have a limited-time discount. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1218170/_Way_Back_Home/?curator_clanid=43593084]Click here to enter the store page.[/url]
Thank you for your long-term support and attention. If you have any suggestions, you can join our player group: 716629726.

Manchukuo Games

notes.title: Release preview of the demo of Mirages! A brand-new PV revealing more about the
notes.notes:
Greetings players! Finally！We're opening Demo on April 3, and all players are welcome to try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43104850/328c0322ba05cfb99e2cc7dcf5e57caa9c25b11a.png[/img]

As a sequel to our previous work, Way Back Home, many old players are familiar with the character will appear with a new look! Although it is a sequel, this one will tell a whole new story, all players can experience without threshold!
Mirages means that crossing from the sun to the yin will also be the subject of this story: The Land of Detention of the Hundred Ghosts Vainly Dead City appears unexpectedly in the game, breaking the order of Yin and Yang. As the abnormal Street Keeper Yao Lu, the envoy, will go to the dangerous place and investigate the reasons behind it.

This story has done a lot of work on the examination of folklore culture, folklore and strange stories, hoping to bring everyone the most "taste" of the "Chinese folk horror" atmosphere. And from Way Back home, 2D evolved into a 3D panel, The environment will be more immersive. Of course, because of the technological improvements, we took a lot of detours and did a lot things wasting our energy, making our production time and costs exceed our expectations. There may be a lot of shortcomings, but we will still try to keep polishing and tuning until the day it officially goes live!

That Mirages can firstly meet with everyone is not easy. Thank you to all those who support you along the way, and finally friends interested in the game don't forget to add Wishlist and click Follow. Don't miss the April 3 Demo! 

Demo does not support English at the moment, we will update it in subsequent versions, please look forward to it!

notes.title: 恐怖叙事游戏《过阴》Steam页面正式公开！
notes.notes:
由漫森游戏工作室制作的本土民俗恐怖游戏《过阴》今天正式公开Steam页面啦！

《过阴》的故事发生在军阀当道的民国小镇，因为种种诡秘原因，导致这里阴阳失衡，离奇诡谲的事件围绕着主角们，将他们引向更加凶险的局势当中......

大家将会在这款作品中体会到3D效果与横板卷轴结合的新奇恐怖体验，为了增加年代感与代入感，团队用心地考究了本土传统的冥司文化，添加了白话文与文言文两种文本，都是为了带来最具中国味道的叙事恐怖游戏。目前demo正在紧锣密鼓地制作中，相信很快就能与各位玩家见面！

喜欢这款游戏的小伙伴们别忘了帮我们点一个加入“愿望单”，可以提前加入我们的官方qq交流群：768185091与我们一起交流哦~~
